purpose: Pre-freeze premise audit. Run BEFORE the protocol freeze because a premise discovered missing afterwards forces an unplanned deviation or a second freeze. Every load-bearing premise is recorded with evidence matched to its TYPE; a physical premise that cannot be tested with available data is marked OPEN-AND-SCOPED, never forced into a repository test that would merely restate the model.

premises.premise: the semi-discrete system is LINEAR in the state, so expm and the A0+kA1 pencil are valid
premises.failure_consequence: the exact-in-time reference and the analytical limit are both invalid

premises.premise: A(kappa) = A0 + kappa*A1 with A1 carrying the interphase transfer terms
premises.evidence: verified structurally: |(A(3)-A(1))/2 - (A(2)-A(1))| / scale = 2.8e-14, and 2.1e-14 at kappa=100. A1 has rank 400 and nullity 201 on the 601-state operator (2x200 grain-transfer rows fast; 200 liquid + 1 accumulation slow), matching the structure the limit argument assumes.
premises.failure_consequence: the analytical limit construction has no basis and P0-G8 cannot run as specified

premises.premise: f(kappa) converges to a trustworthy analytical endpoint f_inf
premises.evidence: stable rank-revealing null-basis construction (cond(N)=1.0, cond(L)<=2.13, versus ~5e10 for the full eigenvector matrix); all projector identities to <=1e-13; 27/27 operator-distinct cells covering all 54 declared cells converge, worst attained error 1.04e-11. The endpoint agrees with the independent high-kappa limit to ~1e-12, whereas the earlier eigen-projector route was off by 4.3e-9 -- the discrepancy previously read as a convergence floor.
premises.failure_consequence: the endpoint classification has no trustworthy f_inf

premises.premise: a sharp output-functional bound localises a finite tail onset kappa_tail
premises.evidence: Not required for P0-G0 or the central P0-G8 classification. Under the WIDE-referenced endpoint architecture the threshold is referenced to J_ref on the resolved finite domain, so no sharp finite-tail bound is needed. tail_onset_status is unresolved_by_design. A future sharp derivation may only enter as a separately versioned pre-result amendment or as a supplemental study that cannot upgrade the frozen same-campaign primary claim; it must not be selected after seeing the endpoint classifications.
premises.failure_consequence: no numerical finite tail onset is reported; endpoint result unaffected

premises.premise: the MAPE level minimiser is the weighted median of y_i/f_i with weights f_i/y_i
premises.evidence: Proposition stated and property-tested against a direct convex reference: the minimiser set is the weighted-median interval and the objective is EXACTLY constant on it, so tie width is inventory-level information and cannot enter a J error budget. Also established that the minimiser is generically UNIQUE here, because w_i = 1/r_i couples weight to ratio; a tie needs n_a/r_a = n_b/r_b and is constructed explicitly. Continuity as f -> f_inf verified, which is what makes the endpoint comparison meaningful. 31 tests.
premises.failure_consequence: J(kappa) is optimiser-dependent and the exact profile claim is unsupported

premises.premise: the high-kappa plateau is not an artefact of BDF time integration
premises.evidence: BDF vs expm agree to 0.000122 % including deep in the regime
premises.failure_consequence: the plateau is a solver artefact and H1 collapses

premises.premise: the plateau holds at EVERY calibration condition, not only the tested centre condition
premises.evidence: all 54 declared cells covered by 27 operator-distinct computations; the pencil depends on (T, p, solute) only and variety enters solely through y, which this model-only module never reads. Deduplication proved, not assumed. No cell dropped.
premises.failure_consequence: H1's generic wording is unsupported; the claim narrows to one condition

premises.premise: spatial discretisation error is negligible for the P0-G8 quantities
premises.evidence: 4e-11 relative between 100 and 400 nodes for the cup concentration; NOT yet shown for J_inf or the shoulder derivative
premises.failure_consequence: the §2.6 error budget understates its spatial term

premises.premise: the corpus transcription is faithful to the source article
premises.evidence: 726 analyte cells and 66 condition rows verified against the PDF, 0 mismatches

premises.premise: the target-grind flow map can be rebuilt without the scored condition
premises.evidence: raw support after excluding upstream polynomial fitting is unquantified
premises.failure_consequence: H3 cannot be cross-fitted and remains retrospective

premises.premise: nine leave-one-condition-out folds are dependent, not replicates
premises.evidence: stated in every archive; no binomial or standard-error language used
premises.failure_consequence: fold sign counts would be over-interpreted as significance

premises.premise: the operational near-optimal set is a convention, not a confidence set
premises.evidence: no likelihood is declared anywhere; Fisher language is absent
premises.failure_consequence: profile width would be misread as calibrated uncertainty

premises.premise: real espresso occupies the large-mass-transfer-coefficient regime
premises.evidence: cannot be tested with available data; explicitly NOT claimed anywhere
premises.failure_consequence: none — the claim is not made; recorded so it cannot drift into the text

premises.premise: the omitted physics (wetting, evolving permeability, fines, poroelasticity, channelling, time-varying flow) do not reverse the plateau
premises.evidence: untestable with the declared model; bounds every H1/H3 statement
premises.failure_consequence: none if scoped; fatal if the paper generalises beyond the declared model

premises.premise: kappa is not a transferable physical kinetic constant
premises.evidence: never claimed; kappa multiplies inherited Sherwood prefactors
premises.failure_consequence: H4 would assert a physical constant it cannot support

premises.premise: the contribution is novel against indexed literature
premises.evidence: requires Scopus/WoS/Compendex; unavailable in this environment
premises.failure_consequence: novelty language cannot be written; P0-G10 blocks drafting

reading: PR-03 is SPLIT per the adjudication. PR-03a is ASSURED: a stable null-basis endpoint converges at all 54 declared cells, so the P0-G8 endpoint classification has a trustworthy f_inf and no finite-kappa remainder belongs in its budget. PR-03b is NOT PURSUED under the current protocol: the WIDE-referenced architecture removes the need for a sharp finite-tail bound, and tail_onset_status is unresolved_by_design. PR-06 is assured. PR-09 and PR-15 are gate-scoped to P0-G9 and P0-G10. P0-G0 remains open because the Protocol V2 endpoint/tail split, PR-04, PR-07 staging and the PR-09 rule are not yet implemented.
